The method aims to calculate the p-values for the correlation coefficients in a correlation matrix. It operates on a correlation matrix and the number of observations (nObs). It iterates over the matrix, computes a t-statistic for each off-diagonal entry, and calculates the p-value using a t-distribution. The method returns a matrix of p-values corresponding to the correlation coefficients.

It achieves this by integrating the probability density function from the distribution's lower bound up to the specified value.  
At line 4, it calls getColumnDimension(). getColumnDimension()'s intention is The method's primary purpose is to return the number of columns in a matrix. It achieves this by accessing and returning the matrix's column dimension property.
